appearances.title: JustVugg/colibri
appearances.summary: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.

appearances.title: JustVugg/colibri
appearances.headline: Colibri runs MoE models in pure C from disk
appearances.newly_possible: You can run large MoE models on hardware you already own with a zero-dependency C engine that streams experts from disk.
appearances.why: Streaming experts from disk lowers the hardware bar for trying frontier-scale open models.
